hannah: Okay the synchronized snort-laugh at 0:42 is my new favorite human reaction. i'm still recovering. :rofl:
ryan: Can't unhear it. Clip pls? need evidence for my therapist.
tess: Uploading clip now, trimming out my embarrassing snort commentary. one sec.
ops-bot: Upload complete: https://redwood.company/all-hands/2517773333/snort-laugh-clip.mp4
julia: :joy: also shoutout to design for the surprise mascot cameo. stole the show.
hannah: snack poll: react :cookie: for cookies, :apple: for fruit, :no_entry_sign: for none. low-stakes but important.
ryan: :cookie: single file defense squad here.
tess: :apple: my dentist thanks you.
omar: also can we get a tiny plaque for the person who fixed the audio mid-demo? hero medal needed.
julia: agreed. propose "Audio Whisperer" title. everyone vote "aye" or "nay"
hannah: aye
ryan: aye
tess: aye (will craft tiny badge art)
confetti-bot: :tada: Afterparty in #random in 10m! Drop your best one-liners and GIFs. :tada:
ryan: "We lowered latency, raised morale, and confused the plants."
julia: "ship it, pray to the coffee gods"
omar: someone archive the best lines into culture-notes, please. i'll start a doc.
hannah: replay poll: type "replay" if you want the recording link here, or "skip" if not.
ryan: replay
tess: replay +1
julia: skip (was live)
ops-bot: Note created: "order more GF cookies, restock oat milk, create Audio Whisperer badge"
ryan: logistics question: can we get a small towel rack in the pantry? crumbs are a safety hazard.
ops-bot: Ticket created for facilities: "towel rack / crumb mitigation"
hannah: ok this was the most delightfully chaotic all-hands. see y'all at the afterparty. leave your GIFs now! :sparkles:
